observer.intro: I watch first. Once there is enough to go on, I ask about your most frequent sources, one at a time. You don't need to set up rules.
observer.spoergsmaal.en: You have spent a fair amount of time in {kilde}.
observer.bagud: The answer also applies to suggestions you haven't confirmed yet. What you registered yourself is never changed.
observer.onboarding: You don't need to set anything up. {brand} watches for the first few hours and then asks who your most frequent apps, repos and sites belong to.
observer.eksport.tekst: Saves the last 30 days of activity with your entries as the answer key. Clients and projects become numbers, and every word in titles, addresses and folders becomes a random code, so the file contains no names.
observer.eksport.gemt: The test set was saved to {sti}
observer.eksport.tom: There is no activity with entries to export yet.
